text:
alex: opened a small TF change to switch ExternalSecrets items for the payments svc from plain secretKeyRef to KMS-wrapped values. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123

maria: thanks for the heads-up — can you summarize the rollout plan? worried about rotation windows and leftover old keys. :thinking_face:

ryan: quick skim looks okay. two questions: 1) will the ExternalSecrets controller re-create the k8s Secret on unwrap/rotation? 2) how are we doing canary/namespace stagger?

alex: answers inline — controller will update Secret in-place when value changes (we rely on owner refs), not recreate. plan is: canary in staging + dev, then gradual prod: 10% -> 50% -> 100% via rollout controller. also adding a 24h buffer before merging to avoid rotation overlap.

alex: Terraform snippet I added (condensed):

```hcl
resource "externalsecret" "payments_db" {
  metadata {
    name = "payments-db-creds"
    annotations = { "externalsecret.redwood.com/kms-wrap" = "true" }
  }
  spec {
    data = [{
      secretKey = "DB_PASSWORD"
      remoteRef = { key = "kv/data/payments/db" }
    }]
  }
}
```

maria: nice. can we use an annotation gate so teams can flip per-namespace? prefer not to force everyone at once. annotation name looks good.

julie: ops note — when the secret value rotates apps that mount it might restart or get a signal; if we flip many namespaces at once we could see a wave of restarts and 502 spikes. recommend narrow canary, smoke tests, and pre-warm for critical services.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/pr-4123 -> staging at 1723456820 :rocket:

alex: thanks — I added a canary list to the PR description (staging, dev, internal-test-ns) and a rollout plan: 10m observation windows between steps. will tag ops and oncall for the prod ramp.

ryan: LGTM pending smoke test. please add a simple kubectl/yq check in the PR pipeline, e.g.:

```bash
# verify secret data exists and is base64-encoded
kubectl get secret -n staging payments-db-creds -o yaml | yq '.data'
```

secrets-bot: rotation-service detected scheduled rotation for kv/data/payments/db at 1723520000 — note: this overlaps the proposed rollout window; automatically deferring rotation by 24h to avoid collision.

julie: ack, i'll coordinate with rotation team and oncall to adjust schedule if needed.

alex: OK — if no further objections i'll merge to main tomorrow EOD and start the canary next week. tagging @maria @ryan for the final quick review. :thumbsup:

maria: one nit on TF var naming, i'll push a tiny follow-up patch.

ryan: reviewed and left one comment on the smoke-test step. otherwise good to go.

alex: great — thanks everyone. I'll keep the PR open until the freeze window passes and then merge. :white_check_mark:
